result:
I added `GET /api/admin/users/recently-created`. It returns a JSON array of the logins of users created in the last 7 days. I didn't run the build or any tests.

- **Repository:** `UserRepository` has a new derived query, `findAllByCreatedDateAfter(Instant)`. The service passes in the cutoff, as `docs/persistence.md` asks.
- **Service:** `UserService.getRecentlyCreatedLogins()` works out the cutoff (now minus 7 days) and maps the users to logins. It is read-only transactional.
- **Resource:** `UserResource` has the new endpoint with the same admin-only `@PreAuthorize` as the other admin methods. It sits before `/users/{login}` in the file.
- **Clock:** `src/main/java/CLAUDE.md` says to inject a `Clock` rather than call `Instant.now()` directly. The project had no `Clock` bean, so I added `config/ClockConfiguration.java` (`Clock.systemUTC()`) and injected it into `UserService`. I found no `new UserService(...)` calls in `src`, so I expect no test construction to break.

The endpoint returns an unbounded list, which `docs/backend.md` discourages. I kept it because you asked for a plain list of logins. If you expect many sign-ups in a week, I can switch it to a `Pageable` response.

I didn't add tests.
